note: Catalog rows and on_bc metadata that the off-repo collector's stale claims/companies.json copy keeps dropping. merge_claims_insider_universe.py re-inserts missing rows and restores metadata when the catalog's on_bc_built_at is older than this file's; a fresher catalog refreshes this file. To retire a company, remove it here first.

meta.disclaimer: Not legal title. Quebec GESTIM, Ontario MLAS operational claims (unofficial viewing data), and BC MTA tenure. Neighbors on Quebec extracts are titles within ~2 km of the company cells. Ontario featured extracts also include neighboring MLAS titles within ~3 km. BC layers are the selected company's tenures only.

sources.ontario: Ontario MLAS operational claims (OGSEarth / LIO MapServer). Unofficial viewing data, not legal title.
sources.british_columbia: BC MTA Mineral, Placer and Coal Tenure Spatial View (BCGW). Open Government Licence – British Columbia. Not legal title.
